metrics.known_limitation: Superseded 2026-07-21 by adding eta=1.0 on top of dynamic_threshold -- the eta=0.0 (deterministic DDIM) + dynamic_threshold measurement is preserved in reports/BASELINE_1CH_DYNTHRESH_GS40.md for comparison. Root cause: DDIM's default eta=0.0 makes the reverse process fully deterministic given its starting noise -- no per-step stochastic injection at all. This measurably suppresses the natural persistence/autocorrelation structure real turbulent wind data has; it is NOT fixed by more steps (tried steps=200, no change) or by dynamic_threshold alone. Setting eta=1.0 (matching ancestral DDPM's own stochasticity) fixed most of it: ACF RMSE 0.100/0.142/0.135 -> 0.060/0.108/0.101, and every other gate improved substantially alongside it (marginal_wasserstein 3.62/2.72/3.60 -> 2.25/2.00/2.11, low regime_accuracy jumped 0.58 -> 0.69). mid regime_accuracy stayed flat (0.43 -> 0.41) -- still the one open problem across every configuration tried this session. See presentation_plots/ for the mechanism trace behind this (DDIM steps=50/200/eta=0 vs eta=1 vs ancestral T=200 comparison).

2ch.channel_description: windspeed decomposed into wind-vector U/V components

recommended_generation.note: guidance_scale MUST stay 1.0 (disabled) for this preset -- guidance measurably breaks it even with dynamic thresholding on (ramp_wasserstein explodes to 3.5/1.9 for low/mid; see known_limitation). eta=1.0 (which is a clear win for 1ch/3ch) was tested here too and is MIXED, not adopted as default -- see known_limitation. Also requires training with joint_consistency_channels=[0,1], joint_consistency_weight=1.0 (not the config.py default) -- this checkpoint (ddpm_transformer_2ch_jointloss_w1_e60_run) is not a default-recipe checkpoint.

2ch.known_limitation: Substantially improved 2026-07-21, but still not a fully solved preset -- do not treat as equivalent to 1ch/3ch. History: originally measured BROKEN (synthetic speed ~2.8x inflated vs real, 100% of days landing in the 'high' bucket regardless of request) and root-caused to a sampling-time clip-boundary instability specific to jointly modeling a 2D vector magnitude (U/V) -- see reports/2CH_CLAMP_INVESTIGATION.md. A training-time joint-consistency loss (joint_consistency_weight=1.0) gave a partial fix (2.8x -> 1.4x inflation, plateaued). Dynamic thresholding, layered on top of that same checkpoint, closes most of the remaining gap: marginal_wasserstein 8.0/4.2/3.2 (joint-loss alone) -> 4.5/1.5/4.4 (+ dynamic thresholding), now in the same range as 1ch/3ch. Guidance still does not compose with this checkpoint even with dynamic thresholding on: at guidance_scale=40, ramp_wasserstein explodes (3.5/1.9/0.3) and 'mid' requests resolve to 'low' 83% of the time. Use this preset only without guidance. Separately, eta=1.0 (the stochasticity fix that broadly helped 1ch/3ch) was tested here and is MIXED: low/mid improved (marginal_wasserstein 4.5/1.5 -> 3.0/1.0, regime_accuracy 0.31/0.43 -> 0.35/0.56) but high got clearly WORSE (marginal_wasserstein 4.4 -> 5.9, regime_accuracy 0.32 -> 0.12, confusion shows 'high' requests increasingly resolving to 'mid'). Not adopted as this preset's default pending further investigation -- recommended_generation keeps eta=0.0 for 2ch. See reports/BASELINE_2CH_DYNTHRESH_JOINTLOSS_GS1.md vs reports/BASELINE_2CH_DYNTHRESH_JOINTLOSS_GS40.md (guidance comparison) and reports/BASELINE_2CH_DYNTHRESH_ETA1_GS1.md (eta comparison).
